1.consolidated_definition: vulg. . Hambre. Suele aspirarse la ‘h’. (En Andalucía, lambrucia es ‘hambre’. Toro).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Hambre. The aspiration of the 'h' is common. In Andalusia (lambrucia) and in some regions of Puerto Rico (Toro), this term is used to refer to hunger.
